1 · Main theme

Listen for: can you hum it after two plays? The hook is the spoken cell “wa-HA-la” (short, long, short), rising on the repeat and falling in the answer. The loop restarts after 34 seconds with no gap.

Structure of the menu loop: bars 1–4 groove and guitar ostinato · 5–8 hook and answer · 9–12 chorus lift, four on the floor · 13–16 return and talking-drum turnaround.

2 · City Rumble in-match music

Three beat-synced layers. Switch levels while it plays; they fade in on the beat grid. Listen for: energetic but not distracting, nothing fighting speech or effects.

3 · Danger over music

The gameplay test. Starts the match music at normal level, then fires cues. You should always hear the warning clearly and the music should dip, then recover.
